cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Digital Marketing Expert Retention position at Atlas Copco Specialty Rental. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am eager to contribute to your digital transformation journey by creating data-driven customer experiences that foster retention and growth.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this position. I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I use analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and guide decisions, demonstrating my data-driven mindset. My experience with lead generation and email marketing, though not explicitly listed, is complemented by my ability to translate business needs into automated journeys and processes.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my initiative and technical expertise. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD), and ran iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project reflects my creativity, analytical thinking, and customer-focused approach—qualities essential for developing engaging campaigns and customer experience flows.

I am a strong communicator with experience collaborating across functions and cultures. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. My background includes front-end development, which gives me a technical edge in understanding and optimizing digital platforms.

I am excited about the opportunity to work with international teams and contribute to the global Specialty Rental organization. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am comfortable with the hybrid working arrangement in Boom.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit Atlas Copco Specialty Rental.

Sincerely,

tailored_cv:
Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

Core Skills
- Marketing Automation & CRM: Experience with marketing automation platforms (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics) to drive lead nurturing and retention campaigns.
- Customer Journeys & Retention: Skilled in creating automated customer journeys, segmentation, and personalization to enhance engagement and retention.
- Content & Storytelling: SEO blog writing, editorial content publishing, and translating technical solutions into clear customer value.
- Data-Driven Marketing: Proficient in reporting, analysis, and optimization using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads.
- Web & CMS: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools.
- Social Media: Content creation and integration for platforms like Instagram and Facebook.
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1).

Experience
Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings.
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic and support lead generation.
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates.
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions.

Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment.

Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript).

Projects
mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook).
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO).
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score.

Education
